#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

enum class State { OUTSIDE, INSIDE };

void processOutside(const std::string& segment, int& maxLength) {
    std::istringstream iss(segment);
    std::string word;
    while (std::getline(iss, word, '_')) {
        if (word.length() > maxLength) {
            maxLength = word.length();
        }
    }
}

void processInside(const std::string& segment, int& count) {
    std::istringstream iss(segment);
    std::string word;
    while (std::getline(iss, word, '_')) {
        if (!word.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    State state = State::OUTSIDE;
    std::string current;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int countInside = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            if (state == State::OUTSIDE) {
                processOutside(current, maxOutside);
            }
            state = State::INSIDE;
            current.clear();
        } else if (c == ')') {
            state = State::OUTSIDE;
            processInside(current, countInside);
            current.clear();
        } else {
            current += c;
        }
    }
    processOutside(current, maxOutside);
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << countInside << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
